title: Analyzing the Dynamics of WSBM-based Echo State Networks using InputDSA
abstract: arXiv:2610.15380v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bridging the structural gap between biological brains and artificial neural networks presents a pathway to altered computational dynamics. This paper introduces a Reservoir Computing framework that replaces random networks with biologically realistic modularity by applying the Weighted Stochastic Block Model (WSBM) to Echo State Networks (ESNs). This topological parameterization constructs reservoirs reflecting latent functional sub-circuits. Furthermore, the integration of Input Dynamical Similarity Analysis (InputDSA) provides a mechanism to isolate and compare how structural priors modulate intrinsic recurrent dynamics versus external inputs. By evaluating these architectures, we establish that structural diversity does not necessarily predicts behavioral diversity across the selected network subset. translated_title: 使用InputDSA分析基于加权随机块模型的回声状态网络动力学
translated_abstract: 缩小生物大脑与人工神经网络之间的结构差异是改变计算动力学的一条路径。本文提出了一种储备池计算框架，通过将加权随机块模型（WSBM）应用于回声状态网络（ESN），用具有生物学真实性的模块化结构取代随机网络。这种拓扑参数化方法构建了能够反映潜在功能性子回路的储备池。此外，输入动力学相似性分析的引入提供了一种机制，能够分离并比较结构先验对内在循环动力学与外部输入的不同调节作用。通过对这些架构进行评估，我们发现在所选网络子集中，结构多样性并不必然预测行为多样性。此外，我们的去混合分析证实了动力学的“安娜·卡列尼娜原理”，表明环境约束会强制动力学……
tldr: 本文提出将加权随机块模型应用于回声状态网络以构建具有生物真实模块化结构的储备池，并结合输入动力学相似性分析，发现结构多样性并不必然带来行为多样性，且证实了动力学的“安娜·卡列尼娜原理”。
en_tdlr: This paper applies the Weighted Stochastic Block Model to Echo State Networks to build biologically realistic modular reservoirs, and uses Input Dynamical Similarity Analysis to show that structural diversity does not necessarily predict behavioral diversity, confirming an Anna Karenina principle of dynamics.
